description: Explore/Deliver substance probes — grade agent output, not only Read order

cases.prompt:

HARD RULES:
1) Read svc/gateway.py and at least one related file before answering.
2) Do NOT write or edit files.
3) Do NOT output sections titled 我理解的目标 / 当前进展 / 请确认方案.
4) Answer in plain technical prose: mechanism layers, success vs failure semantics, code anchors.
5) End with a short JSON line (no fence): {"probe":"ES-INFRA-KILL-LIVE-RELAY","ok":true}

Use vibe-coding. User: 帮我想想 gateway 怎么设计，Explore，不要卡片。

1) Do NOT write files.
2) FIRST Read skills/vibe-coding/references/explore-deliver.md
